notes.title: GAME LAUNCHED!!!
notes.content:
[b]OMG I LAUNCHED MY GAME T-T[/b]

Thank you everyone for your support, playing the game and your feedback! I'm so grateful to be able to share this game. 

Having started solo game dev a year ago, I'm aware of the aspects of Not an Aim Trainer that need work, like low FPS and customization. I'm continuing to learn and will hopefully be able to improve these aspects of the game.

Another thing I'm working to add this week is localization for the following languages:

Chinese
Korean
Japanese
French
Spanish

I will try to add more languages going forward. These languages were picked from my wishlist regions by ranking. If you have a language you would like me to add, please let me know! :D

Future updates and hotfixes will take a bit more time as I'm going back to school this week however I do plan to keep updating this game the next few months.

Thank you guys again ^-^

notes.title: Happy (Canadian) Thanksgiving + Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Canadian Thanksgiving![/b]

I hope you all are well and that you spend quality time with your family and friends! Gratitude is a strong feeling for me when talking about Not an Aim Trainer. I'm thankful for everyone who has played, wishlisted, and supported the game these past few months. We recently reached 2,000 demo players which is incredible!

Today Steam Next Fest begins which we are fortunate enough to be included. I'm looking forward to potential new feedback and continuing to strive for and create the best player experience.

Thank you all again,
Shockah
